name: Preliminary bout
win: the opponent is knocked out or yields (or the proctor stops it at 10%)
lose: you are knocked out or yield

phases.name: Feeling out
phases.behaviour: the rolled exam rival's loadout; tests your guard

phases.name: All in
phases.behaviour: uses its signature (its loadout's best technique) on a 20-tick tell

notes: The opponent is rolled from the combat stream among the exam rivals and your classmates' squad (role:classmate_c, role:classmate_d). Judged (see judging)
